item.title: [400] [Sad News] Nintendo Switch 2 hacking shows no signs of progress
item.description:
>The Nintendo Switch 2, released in June 2025, has demonstrated significantly stronger resilience to hacking compared to its predecessor, resulting in no publicly available successful hacks or jailbreaks as of March 2026. While early reports surfaced of minor userland exploits—such as proof-of-concept demonstrations allowing limited custom code execution shortly after launch—these remain non-practical and far from enabling kernel-level access, custom firmware installation, or widespread homebrew and emulation capabilities. Dedicated hacking communities, including forums and trackers, consistently report that no userland or kernel exploits have achieved public release, and hardware-based approaches like modchips face substantial barriers, including undocumented hardware and intentional voltage disruptions. This stands in stark contrast to Nintendo's historical patterns, underscoring the company's enhanced focus on console integrity for this generation.
>In comparison, the original Nintendo Switch saw remarkably faster progress in its hacking scene following its March 2017 launch. Notable exploits emerged within months, with the first arbitrary code execution occurring on November 30th, 2017, 272 days after the original Switch's launch. It has now been over 272 days without any indications of Switch 2 hack vectors. The Fusée Gelée vulnerability (a bootrom exploit) discovered and publicly disclosed by mid-2018, paving the way for reliable custom firmware like Atmosphere and broad homebrew adoption by 2019–2020. The Switch 2's slower trajectory—now approaching nine months post-launch with only preliminary research and no functional public tools—highlights Nintendo's improved hardware and software defenses, likely informed by lessons from the original model's vulnerabilities. This deliberate pace has frustrated enthusiasts but has effectively delayed the kind of ecosystem-wide modding that defined the first Switch's longevity among tinkerers.

item.title: [ 30] Pentagon sends Marine expeditionary unit to Middle East
item.description:
The Pentagon has approved the deployment of a full Marine Expeditionary Unit of approximately 2,500 Marines to the Middle East.


Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth signed off on the request from U.S. Central Command, the officials said. The elite, self-contained rapid-reaction force is being rushed to the region as Iran intensifies its attacks on the Strait of Hormuz.


Iran’s actions have paralyzed commercial traffic through the critical waterway, which carries one-fifth of global oil supplies. The blockade has already driven up gas prices worldwide and created a serious military and political challenge for President Trump.


This surge adds significant ground combat power at a moment of rapid escalation in the U.S.-Iran conflict. The expeditionary unit is designed for immediate crisis response and can operate independently with its own air, ground and logistics elements.


A Pentagon spokesperson declined to comment on the deployment.

item.title: [ 53] Jello Thread
item.description:
I'm a /fit/fag and a poorfag and my building had boxes of beetroot they were giving away free so I grabbed a bunch. Beetroot is one of the best things you can eat for muscle recovery and gelatin is pretty much pure protein with documented results at healing bones and joints so I made beetroot jello to eat post workout. It's actually not bad.

I quartered the beets and cooked them in a covered roasting dish with water and salt for an hour, let them cool then peeled off the skins. Then boiled and mashed them in a pot of water till they disintegrated, then added more salt and unflavoured gelatine. Let the mixture cool then transfer to a container and refrigerate.

I just wanted to share this wacky creation. And to ask if any Anons have any other wild jello ideas? I like making jello.

I was going to add the contents of a couple of magnesium capsules and multivitamins to this mix but I figured it might interfere with the uptake of whatever is already naturally in the beetroot.

Next I think I want to buy a bag of frozen berries, boil them up with sugar and gelatine them for a more conventional jello creation.

This is how jello was made back in the old times.

item.title: [254] /out/ings with a pipe
item.description:
Last thread >>2844498

This is a thread for enjoying a pipe while doing outdoor activities. If you ask why this belongs on /out/, you've never spent
an evening by the campfire with a pipe silently enjoying the nature around you, and you're missing out.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
most adults smoked, so they had a good sample size), had insignificant death rate increases. Nowadays, tobacco is being
legislated against while hard drugs are being legalized. Put two and two together. Tobacco is just another good thing under attack by the government.

>muh weed
Not the time or place. Start your own thread.

All tobacco users welcome.
